decisions.selected: Add an upper-bound cap to the mcp cli dependency (at least 1.19.0 and below 2.0.0) in pyproject.toml.

decisions.rationale: The upper-bound cap is the minimal PEP 440 fix that keeps new installs on the mcp 1.x line while preserving the mcp.server.fastmcp import surface; exact-pin blocks safe 1.x security patches and mcp 2.0 migration is out of scope for a bug fix.

evidence.claim: Design alternatives select Option A, the upper-bound cap, over exact-pin and mcp 2.0 migration.

decisions.selected: Guard the fix with real-import version and import-surface tests (no mocking of the mcp import).
alternatives: Real-import version plus import-surface guard tests
Rely only on existing tests collection-time imports
decisions.rationale: The bug was silent to lockfile-respecting checkouts; a real-import guard that also asserts the mcp major version converts a silent new-install failure into a loud CI failure and would catch a future removal of the cap. Mocking the import would hide the regression.
